meanings.meaning: A person headed for ruin, as if destruction were his parent. In John 17:12 it is Judas, who was lost. In 2 Thessalonians 2:3 it is the wicked "man of lawlessness."

problems.problem: “Doomed to be destroyed” may still be difficult for a 10-year-old. The meaning also does not acknowledge Clarke’s suggestion that Judas could have been saved.
